newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian T-bill rate falls in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian T-bill rate falls in liquid market.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury on Tuesday sold 159 million dinars ($159 million) of 13- and 26-week bills at its weekly auction dated January 28 at rates falling for the second consecutive week in a highly liquid market.
It also repaid maturing paper totalling 80 million dinars.
The issue was at the following rates (amounts in million dnr):
The slide inrates came as the day-to-day interbank rate fell to 6.8125 percent from 7.8125 percent in a highly liquid market.
For the second consecutive week banks offered more for treasury paper.
Banks bid for 552 million dinars of 13-, 26-, 52-week and two-, three-year paper at between 7.3125 and 8.1250 percent.
